oldPropertySemantics.interpretation: On a source-defined tenure scope, the legacy holder/held-position fields describe source-listed readings. Their technical identifiers do not prove an attested office. This classification record does not change any assertion, field identifier, canonical source value or historical interpretation.
oldPropertySemantics.remainingDisplayQuestion: Office holder is retained as the existing generic property label. A context-sensitive source-listed display, if needed, requires a separate explicit presentation change rather than assertion rewriting.

adoptionBoundary: This complete seed snapshot includes all duplicate object copies with the classification correction. Do not append a conflicting partial object shard or use a partial replace-object import. Existing user libraries are untouched; any later migration must use ordinary guarded editorial changes and reconcile local edits.

mapperFollowUp.mediawiki: mapWikipediaOfficeTables generates wikipedia-office-scope IDs from table grouping, then mapOfficeTenureRows assigns office. A future small fix should classify only exact generated source scope identities at the MediaWiki boundary, with a synthetic non-institution source-scope regression.
mapperFollowUp.generic: Do not globally change mapOfficeTenureRows/projectOfficeTenures defaults for explicit declared-office DTOs or Wikidata. An explicit future semantic option can distinguish source grouping from declared institutional input.
mapperFollowUp.newWikipediaProfiles: The Wikipedia profile outputs use source-tenure-scope. This classification record preserves legacy identities and does not modify that module.
